result.summary: Found 2 layout issues: restaurant names are truncated without ellipsis in the horizontal carousel, and the bottom navigation has uneven icon coloring that makes the active tab unclear.

issues.description: Restaurant names in the 'Fastest near you' row are cut off mid-word without ellipsis (e.g. 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated).
issues.suggestion: Constrain card title width and apply text-overflow: ellipsis (or allow wrapping) so names are truncated cleanly instead of being clipped mid-character.

issues.description: Bottom tab bar icons use inconsistent colors (green home vs grey others) without a clear selected-state treatment, which can make the active tab hard to identify.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent selected/unselected style (e.g. filled vs outline, or a single accent color with label) so the current tab is obvious.
